claims: Top-seeded South Carolina defeated No. 4 Oklahoma 94-68 in the 2026 Women's NCAA Tournament Sweet 16 on March 28, 2026.
South Carolina advanced to the Elite Eight.
South Carolina had a 47-28 halftime lead.
South Carolina shot 71% from three-point range.
Ta'Niya Latson scored 28 points for South Carolina.
Raven Johnson scored 18 points for South Carolina.
Aaliyah Chavez scored 14 points for Oklahoma.
Raegan Beers scored 10 points for Oklahoma.
Payton Verhulst scored 10 points for Oklahoma.
South Carolina shot 51% from the field.
South Carolina shot 10-of-14 from three-point range.
South Carolina lost to Oklahoma 94-82 in an overtime game on January 22, 2026, reported by USA Today.
South Carolina continues their run to the Elite Eight for the sixth consecutive year, according to ESPN.
This was the second consecutive season that Oklahoma's season ended in the Sweet 16, according to Facebook.
